procedures.title: Owner Safety Responsibility
steps: Install device to prevent accidents
Operate device to prevent personal injury
Maintain device to prevent property damage
Follow all safety guidelines during installation and operation
procedures.expected_outcome: Safe device operation and installation

procedures.title: Initial Touch 7 Setup
steps: Connect power cable to device
Press and hold power button for 3 seconds
Wait for startup screen to appear
Follow on-screen prompts to select language
Set date and time when prompted
Connect to WiFi network if available
Complete initial calibration process
procedures.expected_outcome: Device fully configured and ready for operation

procedures.title: Touch 7 Daily Startup
steps: Press power button once
Wait for main screen to load
Verify all status indicators are green
Log in if required
procedures.expected_outcome: Device ready for daily operation

procedures.title: Touch 7 Shutdown Procedure
steps: Save all open work
Press power button once
Select 'Shutdown' from menu
Wait for screen to go dark
Unplug power cable if needed
procedures.expected_outcome: Device safely powered down

procedures.title: Display Mounting
steps: Choose mounting location following guidelines
Mark mounting holes using template
Drill mounting holes
Mount display using supplied hardware
procedures.expected_outcome: Display securely mounted in appropriate location

procedures.title: Display Removal
steps: Access rear of display
Disconnect all cables
Remove mounting hardware
Remove display from mounting location
procedures.expected_outcome: Display safely removed from mounting position

procedures.title: Power Connection
steps: Locate DC power connection point
Connect DC power cable
Verify connection is secure
procedures.expected_outcome: Display properly connected to power source

procedures.title: Ethernet Connection
steps: Locate Ethernet port
Connect Ethernet cable to display
Connect other end to router
Verify connection
procedures.expected_outcome: Display connected to network via Ethernet

procedures.title: NMEA 2000 Network Connection
steps: Locate NMEA 2000 connector
Connect NMEA 2000 cable
Verify connection is secure
procedures.expected_outcome: Display connected to NMEA 2000 network

procedures.title: Software Update via USB
preconditions: USB flash drive with update file
steps: Check current software version
Insert USB flash drive
Navigate to software update menu
Select update file
Confirm update
Wait for completion
procedures.expected_outcome: Software successfully updated to latest version

procedures.title: Wireless Server Setup
steps: Access wireless server settings
Configure network parameters
Set up access point or client mode
Save settings
Verify wireless connection
procedures.expected_outcome: Wireless server configured and operational

procedures.title: Touch Screen Calibration
steps: Access calibration menu
Follow on-screen calibration prompts
Touch indicated points on screen
Confirm calibration
procedures.expected_outcome: Touch screen accurately calibrated

procedures.title: Warranty Validation Check
preconditions: Within first two years after purchase date
steps: Verify product is installed according to manual instructions
Verify product is used according to manual instructions
Ensure identification label on back of Touch 7 remains intact and unremoved
procedures.expected_outcome: Valid warranty coverage maintained

procedures.title: Identification Label Location Check
steps: Locate back of Touch 7 device
Verify presence of identification label
Do not remove or tamper with label
procedures.expected_outcome: Identification label found and preserved

procedures.title: Touch 7 Physical Installation
preconditions: Ensure mounting surface is clean and flat
steps: Refer to mounting exploded view diagram
Place mounting bracket against mounting surface
Mark screw hole locations
Drill pilot holes if needed
Secure mounting bracket with screws
Align Touch 7 unit with bracket
Press unit into place until it clicks
procedures.expected_outcome: Touch 7 unit securely mounted to surface

procedures.title: Touch 7 Removal Procedure
preconditions: Access to bottom of unit required
steps: Locate release tab at bottom of unit
Press release tab inward
While holding tab, pull bottom of unit away from mounting surface
Lift unit up and out of top mounting clips
procedures.expected_outcome: Touch 7 unit safely removed from mounting bracket

procedures.title: DC Power Connection
steps: Locate DC connector on rear of unit
Connect positive wire to pin 1
Connect negative wire to pin 2
Ensure connector is fully seated
procedures.expected_outcome: Touch 7 properly connected to DC power source

procedures.title: Touch 7 Display Installation
steps: Verify all supplied parts are present: Display unit, mounting bracket, 4 mounting screws, NMEA2000 drop cable, DC power connector
Position mounting bracket in desired location
Secure mounting bracket using the 4 supplied mounting screws
Connect NMEA2000 drop cable to display
Connect DC power connector to power source (8-32VDC)
Connect USB and Ethernet cables if required
Mount display unit into bracket
procedures.expected_outcome: Touch 7 display properly mounted and connected to power and communication networks

procedures.title: Touch 7 Connection Setup
steps: Connect DC power to power connector (verify 8-32VDC range)
Connect NMEA2000 network cable
Connect Ethernet cable if required
Connect USB devices if required
procedures.expected_outcome: All necessary connections properly made to Touch 7 display

procedures.title: Display Brightness Adjustment
steps: Access brightness controls through display interface
Adjust brightness level between 0-500 nits
Set appropriate level for ambient lighting conditions
Reduce brightness for night time viewing
procedures.expected_outcome: Display brightness optimized for viewing conditions

procedures.title: Wi-Fi Network Configuration
steps: Access network settings on Touch 7
Enable Wi-Fi functionality
Select desired network
Enter network credentials
Confirm connection established
procedures.expected_outcome: Touch 7 successfully connected to Wi-Fi network for tablet connectivity

procedures.title: Configure Touch 7 Access Point Mode
preconditions: No other wireless networks present or desire to keep networks separate
steps: Access Touch 7 network settings
Select Access Point configuration mode
Connect iPad and PC devices directly to Touch 7 wireless network
procedures.expected_outcome: Direct wireless connection between Touch 7 and mobile devices

procedures.title: Configure Touch 7 Client Mode
preconditions: Existing wireless network available on vessel
steps: Access Touch 7 network settings
Select Client Mode configuration
Connect Touch 7 to existing vessel wireless network
Connect iPad and PC devices to same wireless network
procedures.expected_outcome: Touch 7 and mobile devices connected through vessel's wireless network

Ensure mounting surface is flat and clean
Create mounting cutout according to specifications
Connect power supply (8-32V DC)
Connect ethernet cable if network connectivity required
Insert display from front of mounting surface
Secure display using front mount installation system

procedures.title: Configure Touch 7 Client Mode (Wired)
preconditions: Existing wireless network available onboard vessel
Ethernet port available on network router
steps: Connect Touch 7 to router using Ethernet cable
Disable WiFi on Touch 7
Connect router to CZone network
Ensure other devices (iPad, laptop) are connected to vessel's wireless network
Verify Touch 7 can communicate with CZone network through router
procedures.expected_outcome: Touch 7 operates as client on vessel's network with access to CZone system

procedures.title: System Connection Setup
steps: Connect Touch 7 display to CZone network
Connect analog inputs (up to 8)
Connect digital outputs (up to 12)
Connect AC outputs (up to 5)
Connect HVAC controller
Connect keypad interface
Connect party bus network
procedures.expected_outcome: All system components properly networked and ready for configuration

procedures.title: Display Installation Location Selection
steps: Verify mounting compartment size has adequate airflow
Choose location with minimal vibration exposure
Ensure operator can easily access controls and view screen
Confirm proper cable routing and connection access
Check sufficient clearance for release tab access
Verify cable strain relief capability
Position away from interference sources (motors, generators, radio equipment)
Install out of direct sunlight for optimal viewing
Ensure location temperature range is within -20°C to +70°C (-4°F to +158°F)
procedures.expected_outcome: Optimal mounting location selected that meets all technical requirements

procedures.title: Installation Equipment Checklist
steps: Verify Touch 7 Display present
Confirm mounting bracket included
Check 4 self tapping mounting screws included
Verify DC Power connector present
Confirm NMEA2000 drop cable and t-connector available
Check 3A fuse available
Gather screwdriver and drill bits
Collect required electrical tools
procedures.expected_outcome: All required installation equipment and tools gathered

procedures.title: Touch 7 Display Mounting
steps: Using the supplied mounting template as a guide, cut the hole in the mounting surface
Insert mounting bracket and screw to wall using 4 x supplied self-tapping screws
Secure display to mounting bracket by sliding the unit down on the 2 mounting bracket hooks
Ensure bottom edge of unit is touching the mounting surface for proper seating on hooks
Once bottom is properly seated and flush with mounting surface, carefully push top of display until clipped securely in place
procedures.expected_outcome: Touch 7 display securely mounted to surface

procedures.title: Display Removal - CZone Touch 7
preconditions: Display must be mounted in bracket
Ensure appropriate flat head screwdriver is available
If unit is wired, ensure power is off before starting
steps: Locate the 2 release tabs at the top sides of display
Using a flat head screwdriver, carefully push one release tab in about 5mm until it unclips from bracket
Repeat the process on the other side of display until the top is completely unclipped
If unit is wired, remove all connectors first
Carefully pull the display up and away from bracket
procedures.expected_outcome: Touch 7 display successfully removed from mounting bracket

procedures.title: CZone Touch 7 Installation Power Connection
steps: Turn off all electrical power
Verify power supply voltage compatibility with unit
Connect positive terminal to battery + connection
Connect negative terminal to battery - connection
Connect NMEA2000 Network cable to designated port
Connect Network Router cable if required (optional)
procedures.expected_outcome: Unit properly connected to power source and networks

procedures.title: CZone Touch 7 Safety Power Check
steps: Confirm power is completely off before starting
Verify no live electrical connections are present
Check voltage compatibility between power supply and unit
Ensure proper insulation of all connections
procedures.expected_outcome: Safe installation environment confirmed

procedures.title: First Power Up of CZone Touch 7
preconditions: Display must be added to CZone configuration
Display must be assigned a unique dipswitch
steps: Turn on the circuit breaker or switch supplying power to the Touch 7
Wait approximately 1 minute for CZone splash screen and configuration claim attempt
When prompted, enter display dipswitch by selecting from configured devices list or setting manually
Wait for Control or Modes page to appear
Verify Touch 7 is ready for use
procedures.expected_outcome: Touch 7 display successfully powered up and configured for network operation

procedures.title: DC Power Connection
preconditions: Appropriate wire sizes must be available
steps: Connect negative wire from DC connector negative position to battery negative terminal
Tighten screw to secure negative conductor
Connect positive wire from DC connector positive position to battery positive terminal through 3A fuse
Tighten screw to secure positive conductor
If touch screen interference occurs, connect shield to vessel/vehicle chassis ground
Insert connector into Touch 7 power socket
Lock connector by tightening locking screws
procedures.expected_outcome: Touch 7 properly connected to DC power supply

procedures.title: Ethernet Router Connection
preconditions: Touch 7 must be configured for Client Mode Wired
steps: Connect ethernet cable to Ethernet port on Touch 7
Connect other end of ethernet cable to router ethernet port
procedures.expected_outcome: Touch 7 connected to router via ethernet

procedures.title: NMEA 2000 Network Connection
steps: Connect NMEA2000 1M Drop cable to NMEA2000 port on Touch 7
Connect other end of cable to NMEA2000 backbone
procedures.expected_outcome: Touch 7 connected to NMEA2000 network

procedures.title: Touch Screen Calibration
steps: Access Settings page on display
Perform screen recalibration
If issues persist, connect shield cable to chassis/ground
procedures.expected_outcome: Improved touch screen performance

procedures.title: Enable Wireless Server on CZone Touch 7
preconditions: CZone configuration must have unique dipswitches assigned for Display Interface and Wireless Interface
Touch 7 device must be powered on
steps: Navigate to Settings menu
Select Advanced
Select Wireless Server
Enter the dipswitch value assigned in CZone configuration
Ensure dipswitch value is different from Touch 7 Display Interface dipswitch
Press Save
procedures.expected_outcome: Wireless Server appears on CZone network as separate Wireless Interface

procedures.title: Check Current Software Version
preconditions: Touch 7 device must be powered on
steps: Navigate to Settings
Select About
View current software version at top of page
procedures.expected_outcome: Current software version is displayed

procedures.title: Update Software via USB Flash Drive
preconditions: Touch 7 device must be powered on
New firmware file (.swu) downloaded from CZone portal
steps: Copy the Touch 7 firmware file (.swu) to root directory of USB Flash Drive
Insert USB Flash Drive into USB Port of Touch 7
Navigate to Settings > About
Press 'Update Software' button
Press 'Yes' when prompted
Wait for installation to complete (few minutes)
Wait for display to boot to main screen
Go to Settings > About to confirm new Software Version
procedures.expected_outcome: Touch 7 software updated to new version

procedures.title: Configure Wireless Server
preconditions: iPad or laptop for wireless connection (if using Access Point mode)
steps: Set the appropriate Dipswitch configuration
Select desired WiFi Mode
If using Wired Client Mode, select 'Disabled' for WiFi
For Access Point mode: Note the displayed WiFi SSID and password
Connect iPad or laptop to Touch 7 using displayed credentials (for Access Point mode)
Use credentials to send favorites configuration files (.cfp) wirelessly via Favorites Tool
procedures.expected_outcome: Wireless Server successfully configured for chosen mode

procedures.title: Touch Screen Calibration
preconditions: Touch screen performance issues are present
steps: Navigate to Settings > System > Screen Calibration page
Press the 'Calibrate' button
Wait approximately 10 seconds for calibration to complete
Test touch performance
If performance does not improve, connect a cable from the shield position on Touch 7 power connector to chassis/ground
procedures.expected_outcome: Improved touch screen performance and accuracy

procedures.title: Operating Voltage Requirements
steps: Ensure power supply provides between 8-32V DC
Connect to DC Power Connector Phoenix 1777992 MSTB 2,5/ 3-STF-5,08
Verify current draw is approximately 430mA @ 12V during normal operation
Verify current draw is approximately 130mA @ 12V in standby mode
procedures.expected_outcome: Touch 7 display receives proper power supply for operation

procedures.title: Environmental Operating Conditions
steps: Ensure operating environment temperature is between -20°C to 70°C (-4°F to 158°F)
For storage, maintain temperature between -40°C to 85°C (-40°F to 185°F)
Note unit has no ingress protection (IPX0) - protect from water/moisture
procedures.expected_outcome: Touch 7 operates within safe temperature and environmental conditions

procedures.title: Interface Connection Setup
steps: Connect USB 2.0 devices if required
Connect Ethernet cable if network connectivity needed
Connect NMEA2000 interface if marine network integration required
Configure WiFi connection if wireless connectivity needed
procedures.expected_outcome: All required interfaces are properly connected and functional

procedures.title: EC Declaration of Conformity Verification
steps: Verify device complies with EC directives
Check CE marking on device
Confirm documentation includes EC declaration
Validate declaration matches device model
procedures.expected_outcome: Device confirmed to meet EC compliance requirements

procedures.title: NMEA2000 Connector Pin Installation
preconditions: Have access to rear of connector
steps: Locate rear of connector where contacts are inserted
Identify correct pin positions according to pinout diagram
Insert contacts into appropriate pin positions
Verify all pins are fully seated
procedures.expected_outcome: Properly wired NMEA2000 connector ready for use

procedures.title: Touch 7 Basic Kit Assembly
steps: Locate mounting bracket from kit
Locate 1M NMEA2000 drop cable
Locate power connector
Verify all components present before assembly
procedures.expected_outcome: All components verified and ready for installation
